text:
"You either die a retail investor or live long enough to build 
your own algo" 🦇

Built agentmesh — AI agent mesh that watches NSE 24/7 and pings 
me on Telegram when something real happens.

Open source 👇

Every alert ships with:
→ Live price + 52W context
→ ROCE, ROE, promoter holding, P/E
→ FII sentiment modifier
→ Transparent score: 8/10 (raw 8, FII -1, fundamentals +1)

Moneyball for retail. No Bloomberg terminal needed.

Running on a ₹3,000 Raspberry Pi soon.
Constantly improving. Not financial advice.
Alfred doesn\'t trade for Batman either 🦇.
Cool, great work Bharavi as always👌
